slug: 2020-01-24 Namibia Case Study Highlights Importance of Data Policy Alignment for SDG 16.9

facts.fact: The SDG Knowledge Hub, reporting a compendium case study, states that births and deaths are registered through e-birth and e-death notification platforms hosted at health facilities, police mortuaries and civil registration offices and linked to the National Population Registration System; no date is given, so the published date is used.

systems.tiers: national; registers citizens, permanent residents and refugees; databases combined under a unique identification number
health facilities, police mortuaries and civil registration offices
national interoperability layer linking the notification platforms and functional registers to the NPRS
